Commute.summary: Lets through navigation, transit and ride alerts, and calls from family or VIPs. Mutes promotions and social updates.
Commute.prompt: Active navigation alerts, transit arrivals, real-time traffic updates, urgent calls from family members or VIP contacts, rideshare arrival notices, and flight boarding gates.

Deep Work / Focus.summary: Lets through meeting pings, project deadlines, build failures and manager escalations. Mutes chat, social and promotions.
Deep Work / Focus.prompt: Urgent meeting pings, project deadlines, critical build/deploy failures, manager escalations, and calendar reminders.

Do Not Disturb (DND).summary: Lets through emergencies, hospital and emergency-service messages, and urgent family calls. Mutes everything else.
Do Not Disturb (DND).prompt: Critical safety emergencies, hospital notifications, emergency services, urgent family distress calls, and critical system alarms.

Sleeping / Rest.summary: Lets through family distress calls, school and medical alerts. Mutes everything else.
Sleeping / Rest.prompt: Family distress calls, school alerts, medical notifications, immediate family member messages, and vital health updates.

Workout / Gym.summary: Lets through timers, fitness alerts and emergencies. Mutes everything else.
Workout / Gym.prompt: Workout timer completion, fitness intervals, health tracking notifications, and emergency alerts.
